  COALESCE(

  AND a2.title LIKE '%FDA News Release%'

GROUP BY a1.parent_key

WITH mab_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.drugbank_id
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
  WHERE lower(ds.synonym) LIKE '%mab' 
     OR lower(ds.synonym) LIKE '% monoclonal%'
     OR lower(ds.synonym) LIKE '%monoclonal antibody%'
),
target_info AS (
  SELECT
    t.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(t.known_action,'')) IN ('yes','true','1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS known_action_yes_count,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name, ' | ') AS target_names
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  WHERE t.parent_key IN (SELECT drugbank_id FROM mab_drugs)
  GROUP BY t.parent_key
),
patent_links AS (
  SELECT
    l.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
    l.title,
    l.url
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  WHERE l.parent_key IN (SELECT drugbank_id FROM mab_drugs)
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%patent%'
    AND (
         lower(l.title) LIKE '%us %' OR
         lower(l.title) LIKE '%u.s.%' OR
         lower(l.title) LIKE '%united states%'
    )
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%pediatric%'
),
patent_dates AS (
  SELECT
    p.drugbank_id,
    p.title,
    -- Naive extraction of a date-like token starting with '20' (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD)
    CASE
      WHEN instr(p.title, '20') > 0 THEN substr(p.title, instr(p.title, '20'), 10)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS exp_date_guess
  FROM patent_links p
),
date_counts AS (
  SELECT
    drugbank_id,
    exp_date_guess,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM patent_dates
  WHERE exp_date_guess IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY drugbank_id, exp_date_guess
),
top_date AS (
  SELECT
    dc.drugbank_id,
    dc.exp_date_guess AS common_expiration_date
  FROM date_counts dc
  JOIN (
    SELECT drugbank_id, MAX(n) AS maxn
    FROM date_counts
    GROUP BY drugbank_id
  ) mx
  ON mx.drugbank_id = dc.drugbank_id AND mx.maxn = dc.n
)
SELECT
  ds.drugbank_id,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ds.synonym, ' | ') AS synonyms,
  COALESCE(ti.known_action_yes_count, 0) AS known_action_yes_targets,
  COALESCE(ti.target_names, '') AS target_names,
  COALESCE(td.common_expiration_date, '') AS common_us_patent_pediatric_expiration_date_guess,
  COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pl.title, ' || '), '') AS us_patent_pediatric_link_titles
FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
LEFT JOIN target_info ti ON ti.drugbank_id = ds.drugbank_id
LEFT JOIN patent_links pl ON pl.drugbank_id = ds.drugbank_id
LEFT JOIN top_date td ON td.drugbank_id = ds.drugbank_id
WHERE ds.drugbank_id IN (SELECT drugbank_id FROM mab_drugs)
GROUP BY
  ds.drugbank_id,
  ti.known_action_yes_count,
  ti.target_names,
  td.common_expiration_date
ORDER BY
  known_action_yes_targets DESC
LIMIT 50;
